foley provenance SHA still matches technical receipt

rules: A complete negative review is valid evidence and must remain representable; it does not cause normalization failure merely because rerecording is required.
Take decisions are hash-bound to the technical receipt; a rerecorded take changes SHA and requires a fresh review context.
The eight canonical listening checks are evaluated per cue family across its planned variants; UNDER_WEATHER_READABILITY is an additional Foley-specific cue-family check.
Fuel-add and animal-event prop cues use the same human gate as the original crate/rope/shelter cues; no weaker approval lane is introduced.
Normalization never copies or promotes source files. Explicit materialization is a separate state-changing operation.
Fire-start-specific Foley remains outside this review lane while issue #8 is owner-gated.
